abstain.description: Return candidates by default for agent use. Set true only for strict calibrated refusal; current gate has false abstention on answerable queries.

all_sections.description: Return every matching section instead of the best section per document.

artifact_type.description: Optional artifact-type filter; document is the only value currently indexed.

detail.description: ids returns citation/navigation fields only; snippets also returns bounded excerpts.

evidence_status.description: Optional evidence-status filter; unknown means not declared and warrants lower confidence.

kind.description: Optional document-kind filter. Values are closed; see tycho_describe.metadata.kind.

max_chars.description: Optional UTF-8 response budget. Results are removed from the end and truncated is set when needed.

mode.description: Strict keeps calibrated abstention. Exploratory also returns low-confidence weak_results when strict would abstain; weak results are explicitly separate.

path_prefix.description: Optional relative book path prefix, for example book/volumes/v04-.

pattern_ids.description: Optional pattern-ID filters; IDs come from tycho_patterns or frontmatter pattern_ids.

retrieval_mode.description: bm25 keeps the default lexical path; best is the optional adaptive hybrid plus V12-gated reranker.

section_rerank.description: Opt-in section-aware reranking; BM25 remains default. Pair with section_rerank_margin for margin gating.

section_rerank_margin.description: Optional top1/top2 BM25 margin gate for section rerank.

topic.description: Optional topic ID. Values are dynamic from frontmatter; inspect search facets or tycho_outline before filtering.

volume.description: Optional layer filter. Prefer atlas and modeling-and-simulation; v11/v12 are compatibility aliases.
